title: oodar
content:
## What it is

The Gen 1 C host substrate. Compiled openOODA binaries link against the `oo_*` symbols at build time and call them at runtime. Capability tokens (30, 14 NORTHSTAR core + 16 future-state), Landlock sandbox, linear arenas, PQC primitives (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65), OS shims, FFI glue, and GPU dispatch — all in C, with zero ambient authority.

The canonical single-TU build is `gcc oodar.c`. The public API is `oodar.h`; the shared type defs are `types.h`. Both at the repo root.

Extracted from `ooda/runtime/` on 2026-09-03 (v0.1.0). Reorg'd to a 6-per-domain-subdir layout mirroring std's vocabulary (core, sec, fs, net, hw, app) at v1.0.0/v1.0.1. Floor-broken to v2.0.0 on 2026-09-03 with the last 4 cap-gating gaps closed (oo_alloc/free/write_int/read_int/checkpoint/rollback and the 12 oo_weak_*/oo_control_block_* mutators now require capability tokens; 22 crypto_*_internal primitives moved to a private header).

## Install

```
# link against oodar when building from source
ooda build --target=c99 --link-runtime=oodar
```

The runtime is a C library. Compiled `.oo` programs link against it via the auto-generated header. The install path is via your distro's package manager or the C runtime tarball.

## Surface

6 per-domain tactical subdirs (mirroring std's vocabulary), 48 .c files in the umbrella build (api_surface=52 including oodar.c), 1 root ANCHOR.oo, 6 tactical ANCHOR.oo files, 20 sub-subdir ANCHOR.oo files:

| Subdir  | Scope | Beat |
|---------|-------|------|
| `core/` | Universal primitives: str, list, mem (alloc/arena/weak), math, meta | the workhorses |
| `sec/`  | Security primitives: cap (30 tokens), landlock (Pillar 9), crypto (private internals), pqc (PQC-by-default) | the highest-risk attack surface |
| `fs/`   | Filesystem + host OS: os (syscalls, DNS loopback, rlimit), io (print) | the side effects on host state |
| `net/`  | Network primitives: fetch, tls | the wire egress |
| `hw/`   | Hardware: gpu (HIP/ROCm dispatch) | the accelerators |
| `app/`  | Application bridges: actor (OTP-style concurrency), xlang (FFI), hitl (TTY), telemetry (metrics + event bus) | the oodar-native execution model + outside-world glue |

v2.0.0 also removed app/actor/cycle.{c,h} (520 + 60 = 580 lines of Bacon-Rajan trial-deletion cycle detection with zero callers). See CHANGES.md for the full migration table.
